title: EE-107: change verbs, tiers, and vocabulary objects
body: One item: decision EE-107 in `docs/decisions/decisions.json`, status in force, dated 2026-11-02, at head `2a13672`. It records seven decisions Torian made on 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-02. It builds on EE-014 and relates to EE-105 and EE-106. Record only. This pull request does not implement the decisions. `related` points to EE-105 (#161) and EE-106 (#162), which are not on `framework` yet, so #163 should merge after them. No docs change: the decision log is the record, and the decisions reference page renders from `docs/decisions/decisions.json` at site build time. ## Conflicts with `framework` Checked at `cb502f9` against the record at `2a13672`. Decision 2 and decision 3 are stated below as they stand in that record. The four scores and the standing-rule limits agree with `operations/operating-rules.json`. They are not conflicts. ### Decision 2 includes blast radius Decision 2 says each change line gets a tier of low, costly or one_way_door, and the tier is the maximum of four scores: severity, reversibility, time to detect and blast radius. `operations/operating-rules.json` `questions.impact.scores` is severity, reversibility, time_to_detect and blast_radius, and `tier_of` is max. That matches decision 2. ### Decision 3 includes the standing-rule limits Decision 3 says a question's type is verb plus noun plus asking function, routing rules match on that type and the most specific rule wins, and agents may propose standing answer rules, never for deletes or one_way_door changes, and each standing rule needs founder approval. In `operations/operating-rules.json`, `questions.standing.delete` is never, `questions.standing.one_way_door` is never, and `questions.standing.founder_approves` is true. That matches decision 3. ### What is still unenforced `design.diff` lists the three verbs and kinds from decision 1, one kind per line, compound changes split, and a move that keeps the id as rename. `schema/operating-rules.ts` validates the module and does not enforce the verbs, the tier or the standing rules. `questions.routing.rules` is empty. The membership gate does not read the block. ### Writes do not carry a change line `interface/router.mjs` gives record routes the actions read, view and layout, plus write, check and template when the route has them. Command routes get run, view and layout. A write logs provenance with `derived_from`, `decision`, `note` and an activity of write or draft. `schema/provenance-entry.schema.json` allows the activities write, draft, accept, baseline, confirm, move, release, publish, rollback, merge and gate. There the activity merge means applying a decided decision version, and move means a path change. Decision 1 says a move that keeps the id is an amend rename. Decision 5 says every write carries one change line (verb, kind, noun), and that line's tier decides whether the write lands, drafts or waits for a person. `gateOf` in `interface/router.mjs` holds an agent's write as a draft when the record type's `decision_class` is escalate or recommend-approve. `schema/data-model.json` has 128 record types. 22 name a `decision_class`: strategy-or-constitution 14, ownership-or-control 4, public-commitment 3, security-loosening 1. The other 106 name none, so `gateOf` returns null and an agent's write lands unless a gate rule or a holding decision says otherwise. `interface/cli/mentura.mjs` sends provenance as `derived_from`, `decision`, `note` and an optional confidence. Writes default to an agent. `--as person` writes as a person. `mentura_write` in `interface/mcp/server.mjs` and `interface/api/server.mjs` always use actor agent. The API headers are `x-mentura-derived-from`, `x-mentura-decision`, `x-mentura-model`, `x-mentura-actor` and `x-mentura-confidence`. None of these carry verb, kind, noun or tier. ### Private is a flag on the record itself `schema/check-private.mjs` collects `private`, `private_fields` and `sensitive` from each JSON file it walks, and fails when a package `use_model` input names one. It does not read provenance. `privacy()` in `schema/model-steps.mjs` uses those same three fields on the record in hand. `provenanceOf` in that file walks `derived_from` to see whether an agent's record came from a model's output. `schema/freshness.mjs` walks `derived_from` to mark a record stale. Neither walk carries a label onto a derived record. `docs/ontology.json` has no noun named label, marking, private or sensitive. Removing `private` or an entry in `private_fields` is an ordinary write. Decision 6 makes removing a label an amend at the one_way_door tier. The one `security-loosening` class sits on the naive-config record type, which is a different gate. ### Nothing names a vocabulary parent Decision 4 says each record type stands for one noun, and that noun is its vocabulary parent under decision 7. Decision 7 says nouns, verbs and kinds are vocabulary objects with a stable id and a shape, and that every record type, every record and every code module names the vocabulary object it derives from. The check grown from `schema/check-nouns.mjs` is not in the code. `schema/data-model.schema.json` sets `additionalProperties` to false on a record type and has no noun or parent field, so a record type cannot name one until the schema changes. All 128 record types have no vocabulary parent. Examples: `venture`, `handoff`, `customer`, `provenance`. Sixteen record-type ids are also noun strings in `docs/ontology.json` (for example `venture`, `handoff`, `account`, `provenance`). That is the same spelling, not a link the data model records. `docs/ontology.json` version 0.6.0 holds 112 nouns. Each has `noun`, `level`, `meaning`, `standard`, `status`, `function` and `handoff_type`. There is no shape field, and no id separate from the noun string. Verbs and kinds are keys under `operations/operating-rules.json` `design.diff.verbs`. They are not vocabulary objects with stable ids and shapes. `schema/check-nouns.mjs` fails when a retired noun reappears, when a reference id does not resolve, and when membership rules break. It does not require a vocabulary parent or a shape match. `schema/check-data-model.mjs` does not mention nouns. Code modules counted here are `.mjs`, `.ts`, `.js`, `.cjs` and `.mts` files under `schema`, `interface`, `knowledge`, `operations`, `evidence`, `governance`, `purpose`, `platform`, `packages` and `frameworks`, excluding test files (`test.*`, `*-test.*`, `*.test.*`) and generated `schema/types/`. That is 207 files. `packages` contributes none. None of them name a vocabulary parent. Examples: `interface/router.mjs`, `schema/check-nouns.mjs`, `schema/check-private.mjs`, `knowledge/connectors/filesystem.mjs`, `platform/connectors/github.mjs`. The same gap is outside that set. Non-test source files under `console` (17), `site` (39), `verification` (41) and `scripts` (4), plus `eslint.config.mjs`, also name no vocabulary parent. Records: 55 JSON files under `instance/` have no vocabulary-parent field. Examples: `instance/ventures/everything-ecosystem/venture.json` and `instance/ventures/everything-ecosystem/governance/decision-rights.json`. ### Handoff type nouns Decision 5 says a consequential named change is a handoff type noun with required touches and an approver. `docs/ontology.json` marks three nouns `handoff_type` true: `pricing decision` (`required_touches` includes finance, and the meaning says the founder approves), `product decision` (no `required_touches`) and `founder appointment` (term `founder`, properties F1 to F5). No noun has an approver field. Router writes do not go through these types. ## Checks Re-run after the amendment, on head `2a1367268378160dcb6ef2ea514eeabcdf9f51a2`: - `python3 -I schema/validate.py --schema decision.schema.json --file docs/decisions/decisions.json` returned `valid`. - `node schema/decision-affects-test.mjs` returned `decision affects: all pass`. The check that would read `affects` entries and fail until they hold is not built (`site/content/docs/reference/decisions.mdx`). EE-107 leaves `affects` off. It names no new path, term id or record field, and the decision text says the end state is not built yet.
